surface_value: For most people who do not have evidence of nerve root compression with muscle weakness, the first line of therapy includes non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, rest, and physical therapy. Surgery is offered as an early option for people who have evidence of muscle weakness that is being caused by nerve root compression.
